meta.title: Stock count sheet recognition
meta.description: Recognition of the handwritten stock count sheet: digit fields with trocr, the header text with tesseract, checkboxes by dot count. The template defines the zones and the exported fields.
meta.author: CassandraGargoyle

engine.name: Stock count recognition
engine.description: Form pipeline of portunix-reco with the stock-count template

test.description: Fixed test set, never used for training

methodology.description: Fine-tune the digit model on the train set, select the best checkpoint by field accuracy on the validation set, then run the full form pipeline on the fixed test set and compare the export with the gold files field by field.

steps.name: prepare
steps.description: Align the scans to the template and cut the digit cells

steps.name: test
steps.description: Recognize the test set with the full pipeline

steps.name: evaluate
steps.description: Compare the export with the gold files per field

stop_criteria: no better validation field_accuracy for 3 epochs
methodology.evaluation_protocol: A field is correct when the exported value is equal to the gold value; an empty gold value expects an empty export

field_accuracy.label: Field accuracy
field_accuracy.description: Share of fields with a correct value

document_accuracy.label: Document accuracy
document_accuracy.description: Share of sheets with all fields correct

flag_recall.label: Flag recall
flag_recall.description: Share of wrong fields that the engine marked as suspicious
